question: Actual isolated service and policy latency on the available Mac; distinguish one-second policy budget from input-specific application-time assumptions.
inputs: Only original spacecraft and lagged-cart calibration inputs, indices 0-1 per stratum. None of the completed protected inputs is rerun.
method_order: Rotate three cart methods by session+repetition+case index; spacecraft separate block. No outcome-dependent order.
analysis: Descriptive per-session counts, median, interpolated p95, maximum, reciprocal mean synchronous throughput and full-service overruns. No IID confidence interval or worst-case claim; sessions share one host/day.
warmup: All warm-up samples retained separately; no post-measurement trimming. Candidate coefficient caches may be warm; cart implementation clears its coefficient cache per decision.
uncertainty: Clock resolution and back-to-back clock gaps are diagnostics only. Absolute accuracy, drift, sensor age, metrology and actuator latency are uncalibrated; total physical delay remains unknown.
delay_rule: Compare measured parent monotonic request roundtrip to declared queued duration only as necessary timing condition. Early output must wait to the model application instant; no physical command is sent.
recheck: Recheck each returned definite command or dual after measurement by the existing reference. These are separate calibration host measurements and fixed-output checks, never replacements for protected results.
failures: Retain all starts. Abort affected session on transport failure without retrying or changing the scientific methods.
